text: Consolidated condition/trial/innovation/alignment proposals in one epic after reading current hrf/design/model/fit/mvpa-fit contracts and rerunning all supplied demos, including hrf_alignment_review.zip. Existing PHRF-01..16 IDs preserved; added PHRF-17..24. Required scope is 01..22, with independently qualified condition milestone PHRF-21; optional 23/24 are post-v1. Shared energy/criterion/decoder/pooling/sinks coexist with specialized compact/banded/state loops. Removed the trial-readout prerequisite from common streaming integration so conditions can ship first. Preserved every original B0 performance paragraph; added proposed C0 <=30 s, K<=96, same <=256 MiB and <=2 evaluated references, with early PHRF-20 measurement. Fixed-runtime routing cannot hide scans of 60 centers or 19-node stencils. Current source penalty-transport defect is assigned PHRF-17. Plan hashes in all ticket bodies now refer to the consolidated specification; earlier review notes/hashes are historical. Implementation remains open; numerical probes are not Scala performance/calibration evidence.
